mapper.sql: id, isbn, title, author, publisher, publication_date, list_price, active, created_at, updated_at

where.if: (title LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR isbn LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select: SELECT FROM books ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO books (isbn, title, author, publisher, publication_date, list_price, active) VALUES (#{isbn}, #{title}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{publicationDate}, #{listPrice}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE books SET isbn = #{isbn}, title = #{title}, author = #{author}, publisher = #{publisher}, publication_date = #{publicationDate}, list_price = #{listPrice}, active = #{active}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE books SET active = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
